## Samsung Wallet Launches South Korea's First Paperless KTX Train Ticket Service with KORAIL

Incremental Samsung Wallet ecosystem deepening in Korea; not a thesis-moving event but consistent with Samsung's effort to expand mobile services penetration in its home market.

- Samsung Wallet has launched a paperless train ticket capability in partnership with KORAIL, South Korea's national rail operator.
- Headlines describe it as South Korea's first paperless train ticket service, extending to KORAIL offline counters.
- Classifier flags limited direct investment relevance; framed as a consumer ecosystem feature.
